hero.headline: AI Engineer & Consultant
hero.subheadline: I build AI systems and automation for real business workflows — from document processing and internal tools to content operations and multi-step AI agents.

about.body: I'm an AI engineer focused on applied AI and automation. I work on the parts that turn a prototype into something people can actually use: orchestration, integrations, data handling, review flows, and deployment.

highlights: Co-founded Gotiq to build AI automation and custom software for operational workflows.
Build AI applications, internal tools, and integrations that connect existing business systems.
Build AI workflows and automation systems using FastAPI and GCP.
Orchestrate Claude Opus and GPT-Codex workflows, reducing runtime from 12 min to 3 min.
Build AI education tools for kids and women.
Create practical learning workflows that help people use AI tools.
Built multimodal intake automation with Notion, n8n, and OpenAI.
Implemented manual-review routing, duplicate protection, and audit logging.
Passed acceptance tests for text, DOCX, PDF, Excel, images, and MP4/audio.
Analyzed existing workflows to identify automation opportunities and bottlenecks.
Built AI applications and workflow automation using Python, Next.js, n8n, APIs, and LLMs.
Built Next.js interfaces and FastAPI/Django backend systems.
Delivered service pipelines, CRM workflows, and reporting systems.
